exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Holidays: Do you prefer spending holidays with friends or with family? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Holidays: What kind of holiday accommodation do you like to stay in? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Holidays: What plans do you have for your next holiday?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Holidays: Is your city or region a good place for other people to visit on holiday? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a car journey you made that took longer than expected. You should say: - where you were going - who you were with - how you felt during the journey and explain why this car journey took longer than expected.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Driving a car: How interested are young people in your country in learning to drive?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Driving a car: What are the differences between driving in the countryside and driving in the city?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Driving a car: Do you consider most drivers where you live to be good drivers?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Electric cars: How popular are electric cars in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Electric cars: In what ways could more people be persuaded to buy electric cars?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Electric cars: Do you think all cars will be electric one day?
